lead: `bun nv scaling --iterations` (`tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts`) takes about 30 minutes, and it names the benches that fail before its last summary lines.
body: If you pipe it through `Select-Object -Last N` or `tail`, you keep the counts and lose which benches failed, and getting the names back costs another full run. Start it with `bun nv bg`, which keeps the whole output, and read the failing names from that.
